resources.string: Enter the number of someone you know. If they are in Nyutag, you can write to them right away. If not, send them an invitation.
Invite them: send a link by SMS or any messenger, or show the QR code. The invitation works once and for 7 days.
Point the camera at the code: the link opens sign-up
